analysis.reasonEn: RSI moved from 27.1 to 34.7, exiting oversold territory. MACD histogram improved from -4275 to -1663, signaling bottoming action. ADX at 33.0 indicates a clear trend, but the -DI (38.7) remains higher than +DI (16.2), suggesting downward pressure. Volume ratio below 1.0 for 5 consecutive days indicates subdued activity. Current price of $69,955 is above the swing support at $68,045 but below the swing resistance at $80,380. Trend reversal signals remain weak, warranting a wait-and-see approach.
